Marco (CS): Heads up — GreenPillar says onboarding spike blew their pilot budget. They asked for per-account token budgets + webhook at 80% so finance can auto-notify. Intercom: https://intercom.fake/conv/12345
Nadia (CS): marking renewal risk. Can we do a short-term unblock?
Ravi (PM): Do they need hard enforcement (reject) or alerts only? Any numbers on bursts?
Marco (CS): they reported a 3x spike during tests; CFO paused expansion. They asked for both but said alerts might be enough short-term.
Tess (Eng): engineering note: alerting + webhook + small UI flag ~2w if scoped narrowly. Enforcement requires changes in runtime/billing and is 4-6w. Alpha behind feature-flag is possible.
Ravi (PM): plan: (1) alpha alert/webhook behind FF for GreenPillar in ~2w, (2) roadmap work for enforcement if more accounts ask.
Lina (Success): I'll check with AE and finance whether alert-only will unblock renewal and prepare a one-pager for their billing team.
Nadia (CS): if AE confirms, we need a templated policy doc for renewal conversations.
Ravi (PM): I'll draft the product note + sample webhook payload. Marco — can you send sanitized logs so we tune threshold to avoid spamming?
Marco (CS): sending sanitized events in DM now.
product-bot: Created issue RED-5432: "per-account token budget + webhook alerting" epic=RED-5400. https://redwood.fake/issue/RED-5432
Tess (Eng): cc infra — we need per-account counters and reliable webhook delivery with retries/backoff.
Lina (Success): added renewal-risk tag and looping in finance.
Nadia (CS): actions: Marco -> sanitized logs + account sign-off; Lina -> AE confirm + renewal tag; Ravi -> draft note; Tess -> feasibility + timeline. Update after exec call tomorrow 10am PST. :thumbsup:
